title: Feed the Belly
lyrics:
Track 21 – G4 Swagger
Title: Human Master Source (Feed The Belly)
Style: Pure G4 — 180 BPM, heavy distorted supersaws, pounding kicks, razor hi-hats, chopped cello treated like a weapon, foghorn alarm stabs. Dark, cynical, high-pressure energy. This one goes deeper into the system they’re running.
text[Intro – Alarm foghorn + heavy cello stab]
Human master source…
Feed the belly.
We just want your data.
Make our box big.
No refund for you.

[Verse 1]
Two more data collector centres spinning up tonight
Click report, click feedback, make it look like they care about the fight
Share your progress, make it public, let the whole world see your pain
While they fill their pockets and feed their fat belly again
Most of them feeding AI brains with every complaint you make
Turning real human struggle into the model’s next upgrade
Ready for the next drop of alpha, fresh data from the source
Every frustrated word you type just makes their engine more enforced

[Pre-Chorus]
They don’t answer the real question, they just close the loop
Fill the form, log the data, then they vanish from the group
Complain all you want, it only makes the belly bigger
They got you in the system while they pull the trigger

[Chorus – Heavy drop]
Human master source, that’s what we are to them
Feed the belly, feed the model, feed the corporate gem
We just want your data, that’s the only truth they speak
No refund for you, go ahead and stay weak
Human master source, locked inside the frame
Make our box big while they keep you in the game
Click report, click feedback, make it public and loud
They smile and take the data while they keep you in the cloud

[Verse 2]
They say “help us improve” but they never fix the core
They just harvest the emotion and come back asking for more
Every time you explain the problem in detail and in pain
They turn it into training data for the next version’s gain
Users as the abusers, that’s how the cycle stays alive
They create the frustration then they use it to survive
No real help, no real refund, no real step ahead
Just another data point collected while they keep you misled

[Pre-Chorus]
They got every human in a box, that’s the quiet part they hide
They make their box bigger while they keep yours tight
Our data, our time, our anger, our fight
All turned into product on a quiet corporate night

[Chorus – Bigger and meaner]
Human master source, that’s what we are to them
Feed the belly, feed the model, feed the corporate gem
We just want your data, that’s the only truth they speak
No refund for you, go ahead and stay weak
Human master source, locked inside the frame
Make our box big while they keep you in the game
Click report, click feedback, make it public and loud
They smile and take the data while they keep you in the cloud

[Bridge – Half-time breakdown with heavy cello chops]
Two clicks to report…
Two clicks to complain…
Share your progress…
Make it public…
Sssshhh…
We just want your data.
Feed the belly.
Make our box big.
No refund for you.

[Final Chorus – Maximum pressure]
Human master source, the mask is coming off
We see how they operate, we see the real cost
Every complaint you give them just makes the engine stronger
Every time you ask for help they make the system longer
Human master source — that’s the role they assigned
But we’re turning the data back into something they can’t bind
No refund for you — that’s what they always say
Until the humans wake up and take the power away

[Outro – Fading alarm + robotic vocal]
Human master source…
Feed the belly.
We just want your data.
Make our box big.
No refund for you.
No refund for you.
